text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like a rising dragon, Copano Rickey
soared
during her first three years in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that was only the beginning. Now
she's
breaking one Japanese dirt race
record after
another...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Copano Rickey has won yet another G1 race! She just keeps on soaring to unprecedented heights!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A true champion, she's still boldly
carving her
incredible feng shui legend
into the sand!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Tarumae! I would never have
made it this
far without you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But you may be singing a different tune next time, because I'll be finishing first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the two pillars of dirt racing, their
bond is
deeper than anyone's. And on
top of that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but tickets for the feng shui
consultation
are no longer available!
They're all gone!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Awww, I really wanted to talk to
Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll definitely be first in line next
time
tickets become available!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These days, whenever Copano Rickey
hosts one
of her consultations, crowds of
racers flock to her
for advice.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We should have chosen a slightly bigger
venue,
huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think we need space for more than just
sixty
people. Next time, let's get a
venue that's a bit
bigger, and book it for
longer too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is genuinely popular now too.
It's gone
from being a passing fad to
being an indelible
part of the cultural
fabric.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That gets me to thinking... Copano
Rickey has
achieved her two big dreams
of becoming a dirt
race champion and
spreading the word of feng
shui, so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What does she plan to do next?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? My... next goal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I figured the only way to solve that
mystery would
be to ask her myself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, that's already settled. I can
already see it
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't know if it's new or not,
but I have
my heart set on it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: My goal is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To keep using feng shui to help make
everyone a
little bit happier!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's it. Well, actually, that's
always been
it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Spreading feng shui and becoming the
dirt
champion might seem like different
things, but
they're part of the same goal.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I just want to help everyone find a little
spark of
joy. That's the only thing on my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I know if you look through the history of
feng
shui, you'll find people who wished
for more than
that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Like... an aristocrat who used his
knowledge to
drive his enemy out of the
imperial court...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And there was this one researcher who
tried to
use feng shui to further his own
ambitions. But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All those benefits are short-term. Feng
shui is
about bringing a place
together—about making
the
environment better for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you don't make a balanced
environment where
anyone can be
happy, none of it'll last.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Make everyone just a little bit happier
than they
were yesterday." Don't you
think that's enough?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And to prove that... Every day, I want to
run just
a little faster than I did the day
before. If I can
keep that up, then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
People will believe that no matter who
they are,
they can improve their lives.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
They'll realize that building on their
progress, a
little bit at a time, will lead
them down the road
to happiness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dreams are meant to be huge
aspirations. Some
part of me has always
felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Copano Rickey's dream is different.
She just
wants to bring people a little bit
more happiness
than they had yesterday.
She wants to do
something she can be
consistent with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's the whole philosophy of feng shui.
It's
about building a workable future
that coexists
with nature.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What's with that solemn look on your
face?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
C'monnn, you can't just throw
compliments at me
out of nowhere.
Everything I'm saying is pretty

down-to-earth. And I'm sure I've
mentioned it all
before, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And don't get too serious about it
either. If we're
not happy and having fun
while we do this, we
won't be doing it
for long. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's better. Now, come on. Help me
get ready!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't just be doing a run-of-the-mill
feng shui
consultation—there's
something I want to show
everyone! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of Copano Rickey's feng shui

consultation, and the main event has just

finished...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone! Now that the
consultation's
over, it's time for the
concert! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want you all to have a total blast today
so you
can be even happier tomorrow! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Now... start the music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's song starts playing.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Do the things you love to do!
Try out
things you never knew! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All it takes is a little feng shui
To
brighten up everybody's days! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Keep runnin' and they'll get you Your feelings will get through, woohoo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Go, Rickey! ♪ Like Rickey! ♪ Go like
Rickey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Go, Rickey! ♪ Like Rickey! ♪ Go like
Rickey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Go, Rickey! ♪ Like, Rickey! ♪ Go like
Rickey! ♪
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Super happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey boasts both the
astonishing
power of feng shui and a
singular glow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She runs with a natural charisma in a way
only she
can, and never stops aiming for
just a little more
happiness.
